wp_rest_batch_auth_bypass.description: WordPress REST API batch route confusion (CVE-2026-63030, part of wp2shell). A batch request to /wp-json/batch/v1 can include sub-requests to authenticated-only endpoints. The batch handler processes them without per-sub-request auth checks. Chained with CVE-2026-60137 (SQLi) for unauthenticated RCE. Fixed in WP 6.9.5 / 7.0.2.

probes.description: Check if REST batch endpoint exists
WordPress user enumeration via REST API — if returns user list without auth, API is exposed

wp_xmlrpc_abuse.description: WordPress XML-RPC brute force and SSRF. xmlrpc.php accepts multicall for credential stuffing amplification, and pingback.ping for SSRF/port scanning. Generic WordPress presence check.

probes.description: Check if XML-RPC is enabled (should return 405 or XML fault, not 404)

wp_debug_log_exposure.description: WordPress debug.log exposure. WP_DEBUG_LOG writes errors to wp-content/debug.log which may contain credentials, paths, and SQL queries.

probes.description: Direct access to debug.log — if readable, contains PHP errors with paths, DB queries, possibly credentials
